classes.description: Class names to filter out from the filtered output cloud.

output_format.description: Filtered output point format. Empty string preserves the input format.

apply_to_segmentation.description: Whether to also remove filter.classes from the segmentation pointcloud output.

iou_nms_search_distance_2d.description: Maximum 2D distance between object centers considered for IoU NMS.

iou_nms_threshold.description: IoU threshold above which the lower-scoring box is suppressed.

yaw_norm_thresholds.description: Per-class minimum sine/cosine norm for yaw. Boxes below threshold are discarded.

distance_bin_upper_limits.description: Ordered upper bounds of radial distance bins in meters.

min_confidence_scores.description: Per-class arrays of minimum confidence scores, one value per distance bin.

onnx_path.description: Path to the encoder ONNX file.

engine_path.description: Path to the encoder TensorRT engine file.

workspace_size.description: TensorRT builder memory-pool limit in bytes for this engine.

voxels_num_min.description: TensorRT profile minimum voxel count per encoder stage (input level first, then one entry per pooling stride). 1 everywhere is safe: the node rejects empty frames itself.

voxels_num_opt.description: TensorRT profile optimum voxel count per encoder stage, the shape kernels are tuned for; between the stage's min and max. Set it to the typical or realistic worst-case count seen on representative data.

voxels_num_max.description: TensorRT profile maximum voxel count per encoder stage, non-increasing across stages. Sizes each stage's profiles and buffers, so it sets the GPU memory; a frame whose level would exceed it is truncated (the voxels with the largest serialization codes are dropped) until every level fits. Set it from measured per-stage peaks with a margin.

onnx_path.description: Path to the segmentation head ONNX file.

engine_path.description: Path to the segmentation head TensorRT engine file.

source_reconstruction.description: Controls mapping of voxel predictions back to source points. 'none': voxel representative points; 'partial': cropped source points inside point_cloud_range; 'full': full input cloud with unknown label 255 for out-of-range points.

class_mapping.description: Mapping from each segmentation3d.class_names entry to a PointCloudClassification value. Keys must match class_names exactly and every class_names entry must be present.

workspace_size.description: TensorRT builder memory-pool limit in bytes for this engine.

onnx_path.description: Path to the detection head ONNX file.

engine_path.description: Path to the detection head TensorRT engine file.

allow_remapping_by_area_matrix.description: Flat row-major matrix (num_classes x num_classes) of allowed class remappings by area.

min_area_matrix.description: Flat row-major matrix (num_classes x num_classes) of minimum bounding box areas for remapping.

max_area_matrix.description: Flat row-major matrix (num_classes x num_classes) of maximum bounding box areas for remapping.

workspace_size.description: TensorRT builder memory-pool limit in bytes for this engine.

plugins_path.description: Path to the TensorRT plugins shared library.

trt_precision.description: How the TensorRT engines are built. "fp16" and "fp32" request a precision for a weakly typed build, letting the builder assign tensor precisions. "strongly-typed" takes every tensor precision from the model itself.

cloud_capacity.description: Point cloud buffer capacity. Must be at least the maximum expected number of points per frame.

densification_world_frame_id.description: World frame used to compensate the ego motion of cached sweeps.

densification_num_past_frames.description: Number of past lidar frames concatenated with the current frame as network input.
